The '''NX-1200''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] model in use during the [[Galactic War]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ari Skyff]] owned one such ship which he called ''[[Corvani]]''. [[Giana Kayl]] was another such owner, who called her vessel ''[[Meridian Grace]]''.
